title: Gas Station
keyIdea: If the total gas is less than the total cost, no start works. Otherwise, drive from a candidate start keeping a tank; whenever it goes negative at i, every station from start to i fails too, so restart at i + 1. The last start is the answer.

approaches.name: Greedy one pass
approaches.idea: I wrote this one (you didn't paste code). total and tank both add gas[i] − cost[i]; if tank < 0, start = i + 1 and tank = 0; return start if total ≥ 0 else −1.

quiz.q: Tank goes negative at i starting from s. Why skip all of s..i?
options: Any station between them is reached from s with tank ≥ 0, so starting there with 0 is no better
Only s fails, the others must be checked

quiz.q: Why is total ≥ 0 enough to trust the final start?
options: start survives to the end, and the stations before it have a net surplus that covers the wrap-around
